svg.title: Interleaved Bloom filters and stacked Fuse filters
svg.desc: Highlighted Bloom slices are combined by AND. Highlighted Fuse fingerprint slices are combined by XOR and compared with 1011. Both queries return 1 1 0 1. A separate curved arrow generates the k-mer's fingerprint; a dashed arrow supplies that fingerprint for comparison with the reconstructed fingerprints, shown green for a match and red otherwise.
